proposal.description_long: During CNN’s January 20, 2021 coverage of the presidential transition, White House correspondent Kate Bennett said moving vans had been spotted at the home of Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump that week. In the same exchange, she said it was not yet clear where the couple would go next and mentioned possible residences. This transcript supports an attributed report that moving vans were seen near the household during the transition. It does not identify College Hunks Hauling Junk, establish that a junk-removal service was hired, show what items were moved, or provide the date or contents of a photograph. The New York Times URL in the original record concerns the January 6 investigation and does not corroborate the vehicle sighting. This proposed draft therefore removes the unsupported “junk removed” assertion and narrows the title and text to what the CNN transcript actually says. The original claim about a junk-removal job is not substantiated. The personal household observation also has no documented public-business or government-funds connection in the supplied evidence, so the original human-rights and immigration tags are removed. The narrow observation is factual as an attributed news report; its relevance to the broader collection should be considered separately.
